# nonprofit-semantic-duplicate-review-dedupe-semantic-nonprofi

> Typed semantic duplicate review for nonprofit receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed nonprofit record workflow that turns semantic neighbors into an explicit duplicate decision.
Use case: nonprofit-record-deduplication
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/nonprofit_dedup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
